card.name: Frequency words just before daily
card.fires_on: The word right before "daily" in dosing schedules, such as once, twice, total, or the hyphen-d in once-daily. It sits where "daily" is expected next.

modes.label: Once/twice before daily
modes.description: Frequency word such as once or twice that is followed by daily.

modes.description: The hyphen and d that begin a split-up "daily" after once or twice.
modes.example: Administer once<<-d>>aily at same time each day with or
